image_description: A large, ornate pipe organ situated within a church or cathedral setting, characterized by white arched walls in the background. The instrument features a massive wooden case with intricate carvings and multiple tiers. It displays a symmetrical arrangement of vertical metal pipes of varying heights, creating a stepped silhouette. The lower section consists of detailed wood paneling, while the upper sections showcase the pipe arrays and decorative wooden structures.
